sub: 13 new features for everyday use, no coding required

lado_card.t: All 13 new features on one page
lado_card.texto: Each feature includes what it is, how to turn it on, what to avoid, and a ready-to-copy prompt.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · inema.club · Guide to the 13 new features · Guide: how to learn artificial intelligence

inicio.kicker: Course · 7 lessons · Claude Code updates in practice
inicio.titulo: Claude Code 2.0 in Practice: New Features That Change Your Day
inicio.lead: Claude Code added side chat, split screen, helpers, phone control, cloud work, its own browser, mods, and more. In seven short lessons, you’ll try each feature on a real task with a ready-to-use prompt, and see what you can use today. Duet and Motion are introduced, not tested.

cta2.t: Open the guide to all 13 new features

inicio.capa_alt: A desk at night: a laptop with two windows side by side and a phone next to it showing a plan to approve.
inicio.aulas_sub: From an overview of the new features to making them part of your routine: organizing, delegating, using apps and sites, working away from your computer, sharing work with others, and customizing.

itens: People who create content, teach, or run a small business and already use Claude.
People who have heard of “Claude Code 2.0” and want to know what really changed.
People who don’t code and want to use Claude Code with ready-to-use prompts.

blocos.t: What you’ll be able to do
itens: Organize projects into sections and ask questions in a side chat without cluttering the conversation.
Split a big task among helpers.
Let Claude use apps and websites for you, safely.
Follow along on your phone and send research to the cloud.
Customize Claude with slash commands and mods.
In the Claude app for Mac or Windows (Code tab).
Terminal only if you want (optional): the entire course works in the app.
Paid plan: Pro, Max, or Ultra. Some features are in testing; each lesson will let you know.
